_meta.title: FDRS v2 formula regression fixtures
_meta.purpose: Pins the EXPECTED behaviour of the FDRS v2 score so any weight/amplifier change is caught. Each case has a 9-component vector and an expected score (clipped 0-100). Run with scripts/test_fdrs_v2.py.
_meta.formula: base = Sum(weight[i]*c[i]); amp = min(6*(c0/100)*(c7/100), 6); FDRS = clip(round(base+amp), 0, 100)

cases.name: high_import_high_econ_fragility
cases.desc: Import-dependent AND can't finance imports -> amplifier fires strongly. Should be high.

cases.name: high_import_low_econ_fragility
cases.desc: Import-dependent but can afford imports -> amplifier small. Should be lower than the high-fragility twin.

cases.name: low_import_high_econ_fragility
cases.desc: Poor but not import-dependent -> amplifier small (needs BOTH). Moderate score.
cases.assert: amplifier small despite high econ_access (import_dep gates it)

cases.name: resilient_exporter
cases.desc: Low import dependence, strong reserves, low fragility -> low score.

cases.name: all_max_clips_at_100
cases.desc: Max vector: base 100 + amp 6 = 106 -> MUST clip to 100. Validates the ceiling.

cases.name: missing_econ_access_no_amplifier
cases.desc: econ_access=0 -> amplifier is exactly 0 regardless of import_dep. Validates the calm-by-absence concern.
cases.assert: amplifier == 0 when econ_access == 0 (and note: this understates a real high-import country)

cases.name: missing_grain_buffer
cases.desc: grain_buffer=0 -> loses 0.06*value contribution only; no amplifier effect.
